edges.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is stored into the immutable _token state variable.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is stored into the immutable _beneficiary state variable.
Constructor parameter releaseStartTime_ (rounded to a day) is stored into _releaseStartTime.
Constructor parameter releaseStartTime_ participates in computing _releaseEndTime.
Constructor parameter daysOfTimelock_ multiplies SECONDS_OF_A_DAY when computing _releaseEndTime.
Constructor parameter totalBenefit_ is stored into _totalBenefit.
releasedBalance() derives the vested amount from block.timestamp, creating timestamp dependency.
releasedBalance() compares block.timestamp against _releaseStartTime.
releasedBalance() compares block.timestamp against _releaseEndTime.
releasedBalance() scales _totalBenefit by the fraction of elapsed days.
unreleasedBalance() subtracts releasedBalance() from _totalBenefit.
withdraw() computes the withdrawable amount from releasedBalance().
withdraw() compares releasedBalance() against _withdrawedBalance.
withdraw() increments _withdrawedBalance after computing the amount.
withdraw() performs an external token transfer before control returns to the caller.
The held _token is the target of the external safeTransfer in withdraw().
The immutable _beneficiary is the recipient of the external transfer in withdraw().
A malicious token contract can re-enter withdraw() during the external safeTransfer.
terminate() uses releasedBalance() to recompute _totalBenefit.
terminate() derives _releaseEndTime from block.timestamp, creating timestamp dependency.
terminate() uses _withdrawedBalance when computing the amount still owed to the beneficiary.
terminate() overwrites _totalBenefit with the currently released balance.
terminate() overwrites _releaseEndTime with the current day boundary.
terminate() sets _isTerminated to true.
terminate() performs an external token transfer of the unreleased balance to the owner.
The held _token is the target of the external safeTransfer in terminate().
terminate() sends the unreleased balance to the privileged _owner address.
A malicious token contract can re-enter terminate() during the external safeTransfer.
The constructor derives the initial owner from the caller through _msgSender().
The onlyOwner modifier on terminate() compares the caller with the stored owner.
The onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership() compares the caller with the stored owner.
The onlyOwner modifier on renounceOwnership() compares the caller with the stored owner.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
Ownership checks query owner() before control reaches _setOwner().
transferOwnership() calls _setOwner() to persist the new owner.
transferOwnership() reads its newOwner parameter.
transferOwnership() forwards its newOwner parameter into _setOwner().
_setOwner() reads its newOwner parameter.
_setOwner() writes the new owner into _owner.
renounceOwnership() calls _setOwner(address(0)).
SafeERC20._callOptionalReturn performs the low-level call that backs safeTransfer in withdraw().
SafeERC20._callOptionalReturn performs the low-level call that backs safeTransfer in terminate().
